description: Reticle Lab shows a HUD-style loader for Uno Platform. ReticleLoader is a templated control: a 300-unit reticle with two counter-rotating tick bands, rings, a sweeping arc, a progress arc that fills with the percent and an X that closes when the work is done, read in the order percent, phase, telemetry, with a status line below. Its State property drives Scanning, Locking, Locked, Idle and Interrupted (which keeps its progress and offers Resume) through visual states, with reduced-motion support. A keyed ProgressRing style gives the same look at 64, 40 and 24 px for inline use. The page simulates a workspace sync and has a runtime Light/Dark switch; JetBrains Mono is bundled, and Hot Design previews show every state.

showcase.summary: A HUD loader control with Scanning, Locking, Locked, Idle and Interrupted states, plus matching ProgressRing sizes.
goals: A templated control whose default style carries the whole look, driven by a State enum and a Value through VisualStateManager
Hand off between visual states without snapping, by animating every property in every state with From-less keyframes
Draw a value-dependent arc in code and everything else as Path and Ellipse in the template
Restyle the stock ProgressRing as compact 24, 40 and 64 px rings, with a converter for the determinate arc
Take every colour from the Material palette and bundle the design's typeface through the Material font override
Switch Light and Dark at runtime with the hosted-safe Toolkit SystemThemeHelper, and lay the page out with utu:Responsive
